description: This file contains classes and functions related to network request and response handling, cookie filtering, header management, and WebSocket management within the Playwright core server. It defines classes for Request, Response, WebSocket, and Route, along with utility functions for headers, cookies, and URL parsing.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request, including URL, headers, method, post data, and related response.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response, including status, headers, body, and timing information.

classes.name: WebSocket
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket connection with event handling for frames, errors, and closure.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: Handles request routing, including handling, aborting, fulfilling, and continuing requests.

methods.name: filterCookies
methods.description: Filters cookies based on provided URLs and cookie attributes.

methods.name: isLocalHostname
methods.description: Checks if a hostname is local (localhost).

methods.name: applyHeadersOverrides
methods.description: Applies header overrides, filtering out forbidden headers.

methods.name: rewriteCookies
methods.description: Rewrites cookies to ensure valid URL, domain, and expiration attributes.

methods.name: parseURL
methods.description: Parses a string into a URL object, returns null if invalid.

methods.name: stripFragmentFromUrl
methods.description: Removes URL fragment from a URL string.

methods.name: statusText
methods.description: Returns the standard status text for a given HTTP status code.

methods.name: singleHeader
methods.description: Creates a headers array with a single header.

methods.name: mergeHeaders
methods.description: Merges multiple headers arrays into one, preserving original case.
